generating.title: Ana zana littafin {{name}}
generating.lead: Ana rubutawa, zanawa da duba shi shafi-shafi — i, har idanu muna dubawa. Ku bar wannan shafin a buɗe; yana ɗaukar 'yan mintuna.
generating.failedRetry: An sami ɗan matsala — ci gaba daga inda ya tsaya (kyauta)
generating.needsReviewTitle: Ya kusa — wani mutum yana duba shafi ɗaya
generating.needsReviewBody: Labarin {{name}} da hotunansa sun kammala, amma editanmu yana son a duba shafi ɗaya da hannu kafin a buga. Babu abin da za ku yi — ku ajiye wannan hanyar, littafin zai bayyana a nan da zarar an amince da shi, yawanci cikin 'yan sa'o'i.
generating.rejectedTitle: Ba mu iya sa wannan labarin ya kai matsayin ingancinmu ba.
generating.rejectedBody: Ba a yi amfani da kuɗin littafinku ba. Kuna iya sake gwada wannan ra'ayin ko ku zaɓi wani ra'ayin labari daban.
generating.paused: Littafinku yana cikin aminci kuma an ajiye shi. Yana ɗaukar ɗan lokaci fiye da yadda aka saba — zai ci gaba daga daidai inda ya tsaya, kuma za mu aiko muku da imel idan ya shirya.
